title: Deep learning on CT predicts N2 metastasis and prognosis in clinical stage I lung cancer
summary: A deep learning signature predicted N2 metastasis with AUC 0.82 in an internal test set (n=266), 0.81 in an external cohort (n=133) and 0.81 in a multicenter prospective diagnostic trial cohort (n=300; ChiCTR2000041310), across 3096 patients. Higher scores were associated with EGFR and ALK status and with survival stratification. AUC around 0.81 is modest; training was retrospective. This is the Radiology version of 2021-10-26.
ai_technology: Deep learning signature from CT images predicting N2 metastasis and prognosis
organization: Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Tongji University School of Medicine; Tongji University

evidence.tested: External cohort and a multicenter prospective diagnostic trial.
evidence.unknown: Effect on staging decisions and long-term outcomes is not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning scored CT images to predict mediastinal nodal metastasis.
